title: RuleSetPublished.v1
description: A rule set version was published and is now immutable (plan §6.5 catalogue extension, §7 DEC-4). Emitted by strategy-service on `collections.strategy` keyed by `ruleSetId`. Publishing is the point of no return: the definition can no longer be edited (a mutation attempt is 409) and only a new `version` can change behaviour, which is what lets a strategy pin a rule-set version and trust it. Validation happens before publish, not here — schema, every `field` in the context field catalogue, every `reasonCode` in the reason-code registry, and FORBID_CHANNEL only in a POLICY set. decision-service consumes this to refresh its cache of PUBLISHED rule and policy sets.

ruleSetId.description: Identifier of the rule set family, e.g. `EARLY_COLLECTION_RULES`. Also the partition key.

version.description: Published version. A strategy references exactly this pair (`ruleSetId`, `version`), never "latest".

kind.description: `RULES` = business decision logic referenced by strategies. `POLICY` = a global policy set that applies to every decision and is never pinned per strategy (A§54) — a consumer refreshing its cache must treat a new POLICY publication as immediately relevant to all traffic, which is the whole point of policy being global.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of the canonical JSON of the published `rule-set.v1.json` document. Recorded per decision alongside the rule-set version so an audit can prove which bytes were evaluated.
